SELECT q.no AS q_no, q.title AS q_title, q.is_active AS q_is_active, q.created_at AS q_created_at,
a.post_no AS a_post_no FROM question_post q LEFT JOIN answer_post a ON a.post_no = q.no ORDER BY q.created_at desc

SELECT q.no AS q_no, q.writer_ip AS q_writer_ip, q.post_pw AS q_post_pw, q.title AS q_title, q.text AS q_text, q.is_active AS q_is_active, q.created_at AS q_created_at,
a.post_no AS a_post_no, a.admin_id AS a_admin_id, a.answered_text AS a_answered_text, a.answered_at AS a_answered_at FROM question_post q LEFT JOIN answer_post a ON a.post_no = q.no WHERE q.no = #{no}
